title: Open Values Register Coverage Matrix
description: A generated table that gives every open or built decision a status against every register on the shelf: applicable, not applicable, blocked, or not yet reviewed. A build script makes it from the taxonomy, the shelf and the coverage rules, and it is used to plan register passes.

format.description: Names the file format. Always open-values-register-coverage-matrix.

version.description: The version of this format the file follows. Always 1.0.0.

generatedFrom.description: The four files the matrix was built from, each with the SHA-256 hash of its bytes, so a stale matrix can be detected.

taxonomy.description: Path of the taxonomy file. Always content/taxonomy.json.

taxonomySha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the taxonomy file at build time.

registerShelf.description: Path of the register shelf. Always content/registers.json.

registerShelfSha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the register shelf at build time.

coverageRules.description: Path of the coverage rules. Always content/register-coverage-rules.json.

coverageRulesSha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the coverage rules at build time.

entityInventory.description: Path of the entity inventory. Always pipeline/registers/entity-inventory.json.

entityInventorySha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the entity inventory at build time.

counts.description: Totals for the whole matrix: taxonomyDecisions, targetDecisions (covered plus open), coveredDecisions, openDecisions, builtTargetDecisions, excludedHoldDecisions, excludedOutDecisions, registers, relationships (target decisions times registers) and statuses (how many relationships have each status).

registers.description: One row per register on the shelf, sorted by id, with how many decisions fall under each status.

registerId.description: The register's id from the shelf.

criterion.description: The criterion key the register writes to, copied from its provenanceKey on the shelf.

counts.description: How many target decisions have each status for this register, keyed applicable, not-applicable, blocked and unmapped.

decisions.description: One row per covered or open taxonomy decision, sorted by id, with its status against every register.

kind.description: Where the status came from. shelf-proven means the shelf records a hand-checked citation for this decision. selector means a reviewed coverage rule matched it.

id.description: The id of the selector that matched, when kind is selector.

registerId.description: The register's id from the shelf.

criterion.description: The criterion key the register writes to.

reason.description: Why this status holds, copied from the winning selector or from the shelf proof.

basis.description: Which rule or proof set this status.

applicable.description: Registers whose subject covers this decision.

notApplicable.description: Registers a reviewed rule says cannot supply facts for this decision.

blocked.description: Registers that apply but have a named prerequisite stopping a pass for now.

unmapped.description: Ids of registers nobody has reviewed against this decision yet. This is the default and is not a claim that the register is irrelevant.

id.description: The decision's id in the taxonomy.

cid.description: The id of the decision's built dataset, or null if it has none yet.

path.description: The decision's place in the taxonomy: four ids joined by slashes, from the top level down to the decision.

scope.description: covered means the decision is built in the catalogue; open means it is open for work.

built.description: True when the decision's cid appears in the entity inventory, meaning it has a built dataset with options.

realm.description: The id of the top-level taxonomy group the decision sits in, such as food-and-drink.

field.description: The field the decision sits in, the second level of the taxonomy.

family.description: The family the decision sits in, the level below field.

type.description: What kind of thing the decision compares.

mode.description: How a person comes to have the thing, such as buy, rent or hire.

coverage.description: This decision's status against every register on the shelf. Each register appears in exactly one of the four lists.
